title: GlowScent Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb
body_html:
GlowScent – Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb

GlowScent is an innovative daily hair and scalp care device that combines hair care, hydration, protection, fine mist application, vibration massage, and red LED light therapy in one easy-to-use experience.

Designed to become part of your daily hair-care routine, GlowScent allows you to choose the liquid that best suits your hair-care needs and distribute it as a fine mist while brushing.

 Three Care Formulas

GlowScent comes with 3 refillable capsules and 3 specially formulated liquids, each designed for a different part of your hair-care routine:

 Smooth Shield

Designed to be part of your daily hair-care and protection routine, helping leave hair feeling smoother and easier to manage.

 Hydration Touch

Designed to provide your hair with a hydrated, refreshed feel, making it suitable for everyday hair-care routines.

 Pure Scent

Designed to give your hair a fresh, pleasant fragrance while remaining part of your overall hair-care experience—not simply a traditional perfume.

Choose the capsule and formula that best fits your hair and your daily routine.

Refillable Capsules

GlowScent capsules are designed to be refilled and reused with the specially formulated GlowScent liquids.

How to Refill the Capsule

  1. Remove the capsule from the device.
  2. The capsule will be empty and sealed with a rubber stopper.
  3. Carefully remove the stopper.
  4. Take the GlowScent liquid you want to use.
  5. Fill the capsule with the amount of liquid you need.
  6. Securely replace the stopper.
  7. Insert the capsule back into the GlowScent device.
  8. The device is now ready to use.

Important: Do not use other liquids, perfumes, or formulas in the capsules. Only use the specially formulated GlowScent liquids to ensure proper compatibility with the device and mist system.

How to Operate GlowScent

GlowScent is designed for simple one-touch control.

First Press

Turns the device on and activates Red LED Light Mode.

Second Press

Switches to Light Mist Mode.

Third Press

Switches to Stronger Mist Mode.

Long Press

Turns the device off.

You can easily switch between modes during your hair-care routine.

Red LED Light

GlowScent features an integrated red LED light system designed to be part of your daily hair and scalp care routine.

Use the red LED mode while gently moving the device through your hair and across the scalp.

Vibration Scalp Massage

GlowScent features a built-in vibration massage function designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing scalp-care experience while brushing.

Massage Controls

One touch on the top of the device:
Turns the massage on.

One more touch:
Turns the massage off.

Long touch:
Adjusts the vibration intensity higher or lower according to your preference.

Choose the vibration level that feels most comfortable while gently moving the device across your scalp.

Hair Care + Fine Mist in One Step

Instead of manually applying your hair-care formula, GlowScent allows you to distribute the selected liquid as a fine mist while brushing your hair.

Use:

Smooth Shield for protection and care
Hydration Touch for hydration and refreshment
Pure Scent for hair care with a fresh fragrance

This allows you to combine hair care, hydration, protection, and freshness into one simple daily routine.

1000mAh Rechargeable Battery

GlowScent is equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable lithium battery.

With moderate use, one full charge can last for up to one month when the device is used for approximately 5 minutes per day.

The device uses USB Type-C charging.

What’s Included

  • 1 × GlowScent Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb
  • 1 × Charging Base
  • 3 × Refillable Capsules
  • 1 × Smooth Shield Formula
  • 1 × Hydration Touch Formula
  • 1 × Pure Scent Formula
  • 1 × USB Type-C Charging Cable

Your Daily GlowScent Routine

Choose your formula → Fill the capsule → Insert the capsule → Turn on the device → Select your mist level → Brush through your hair and scalp → Activate the massage when needed → Enjoy your complete hair-care routine.

GlowScent

Care. Protect. Hydrate. Refresh.

title: GlowScent Smart Hair, Scalp Care Comb
body_html:
GlowScent – Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb

GlowScent is an innovative daily hair and scalp care device that combines hair care, hydration, protection, fine mist application, vibration massage, and red LED light therapy in one easy-to-use experience.

Designed to become part of your daily hair-care routine, GlowScent allows you to choose the liquid that best suits your hair-care needs and distribute it as a fine mist while brushing.

 Three Care Formulas

GlowScent comes with 3 refillable capsules and 3 specially formulated liquids, each designed for a different part of your hair-care routine:

 Smooth Shield

Designed to be part of your daily hair-care and protection routine, helping leave hair feeling smoother and easier to manage.

 Hydration Touch

Designed to provide your hair with a hydrated, refreshed feel, making it suitable for everyday hair-care routines.

 Pure Scent

Designed to give your hair a fresh, pleasant fragrance while remaining part of your overall hair-care experience—not simply a traditional perfume.

Choose the capsule and formula that best fits your hair and your daily routine.

Refillable Capsules

GlowScent capsules are designed to be refilled and reused with the specially formulated GlowScent liquids.

How to Refill the Capsule

  1. Remove the capsule from the device.
  2. The capsule will be empty and sealed with a rubber stopper.
  3. Carefully remove the stopper.
  4. Take the GlowScent liquid you want to use.
  5. Fill the capsule with the amount of liquid you need.
  6. Securely replace the stopper.
  7. Insert the capsule back into the GlowScent device.
  8. The device is now ready to use.

Important: Do not use other liquids, perfumes, or formulas in the capsules. Only use the specially formulated GlowScent liquids to ensure proper compatibility with the device and mist system.

How to Operate GlowScent

GlowScent is designed for simple one-touch control.

First Press

Turns the device on and activates Red LED Light Mode.

Second Press

Switches to Light Mist Mode.

Third Press

Switches to Stronger Mist Mode.

Long Press

Turns the device off.

You can easily switch between modes during your hair-care routine.

Red LED Light

GlowScent features an integrated red LED light system designed to be part of your daily hair and scalp care routine.

Use the red LED mode while gently moving the device through your hair and across the scalp.

Vibration Scalp Massage

GlowScent features a built-in vibration massage function designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing scalp-care experience while brushing.

Massage Controls

One touch on the top of the device:
Turns the massage on.

One more touch:
Turns the massage off.

Long touch:
Adjusts the vibration intensity higher or lower according to your preference.

Choose the vibration level that feels most comfortable while gently moving the device across your scalp.

Hair Care + Fine Mist in One Step

Instead of manually applying your hair-care formula, GlowScent allows you to distribute the selected liquid as a fine mist while brushing your hair.

Use:

Smooth Shield for protection and care
Hydration Touch for hydration and refreshment
Pure Scent for hair care with a fresh fragrance

This allows you to combine hair care, hydration, protection, and freshness into one simple daily routine.

1000mAh Rechargeable Battery

GlowScent is equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable lithium battery.

With moderate use, one full charge can last for up to one month when the device is used for approximately 5 minutes per day.

The device uses USB Type-C charging.
